english.title: Use goods vehicle max gross weight of 3500kgs - tyre with less than 1.6mm depth of tread
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight not exceeding 3500 kgs, when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1.6 mm throughout a continuous band comprising the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(4)(e) and (f) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1mm (i.e. larger goods and passenger vehicles) see charge headings: H154, H158 and H160.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H423 and H424.
(iii) See also H149, H150 and H151 in relation to a passenger vehicles.
(iv) See also H425, H426 and H427 in relation to light trailers.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight not exceeding 3500 kg on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The grooves in the tread pattern of the tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) wheel of the vehicle were less than 1.6 mm deep throughout a continuous band situated in the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre.

welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) defnyddiodd y diffynnydd **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) a oedd yn gerbyd nwyddau gydag uchafswm pwysau gros heb fod yn fwy na 3500 kg ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 27(4)(e) y (f) Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, Adran 41A Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
